# Impact of Mobile Phone and Social Media Use on the Health and Well-being of School Children

**Real survey → data analysis → visual reports → awareness → evidence-based recommendations**

This website presents a practical, questionnaire-based study of digital habits and related areas such as sleep, physical activity, concentration, earphone use, family interaction, values and life skills.

</div>

## Project message

> **Technology is useful when used responsibly. The goal is balance—not complete technology avoidance.**

Use the navigation above to explore the **real survey results, charts, healthy habits, parent awareness, child awareness and recommendations**.

<div class="footer-note">
This is a questionnaire-based project. The survey findings describe the responses collected and do not by themselves establish direct cause-and-effect.
